taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: a shrub 1 m to 2 m tall.

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: up to 3 m tall.

traits.life_span.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: a long-lived shrub.

traits.woodiness.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: a woody shrub.

traits.stem_clump.note: Many canes from the base, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 177154494, 318011531, 388065803, 177154496, 89309857, 177447706, 328637493, 330196386): the sources read give no count or measure; the batch 3 review cites Dendrology (2019) p. 323 with the photos for its many stems from the base.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: deciduous.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Leaves in opposite pairs, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 177154494, 318011531, 388065803, 177154496, 89309857, 177447706, 328637493, 330196386): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves 10 cm to 20 cm long.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves 6 cm to 12 cm wide.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: petioles 1 cm to 3 cm long.

traits.leaf_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves broadly ovate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Leaves drawn out to a point, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 177154494, 318011531, 388065803, 177154496, 89309857, 177447706, 328637493, 330196386): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves coarsely serrate.

traits.inflorescence.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 323, Hydrangea macrophylla: inflorescence a corymb, terminal, erect, dense.

traits.flowering_shoot_leaves.note: Two to four pairs of leaves below each head, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 318011531, 125899695, 14822845, 89309857; imagekit batch inat-2026-10-18-3): the sources read give no count; Dendrology (2019) p. 323 has the corymb terminal, ending a leafy shoot.

traits.inflorescence_posture.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 323, Hydrangea macrophylla: corymb terminal, erect.

traits.inflorescence_outline.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 323, Hydrangea macrophylla: inflorescence 10-20 cm in diameter, globose in the Hortensia Group (mopheads), all its flowers sterile, as the photos show.

traits.sterile_flowers.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) pp. 322-324, Hydrangea macrophylla: the Hortensia Group's globose heads are all sterile flowers (Lacecap Group: fertile flowers ringed by sterile ones); a sterile flower is K3-5, petaloid, C0, 1.5-3(-4) cm across, its sepals obovate-rhombic or broadly elliptic. The mophead is the form this spec draws (its globose outline).

traits.sterile_sepal_shape.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) pp. 324-326, Hydrangea macrophylla: a sterile flower's 3 to 5 petaloid sepals are obovate-rhombic or broadly elliptic, narrowed at the base, spreading. Read as orbicular: in the photos the mophead's sepals are nearly as broad as long and overlap at their margins (iNaturalist observations 388065803, 328637493, 304694460, 318011531; fetched with imagekit, batch inat-2026-10-18-3), where obovate drew them two thirds as broad, with gaps.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 323, Hydrangea macrophylla: inflorescence 10-20 cm in diameter; globose, all flowers sterile, in the Hortensia Group the photos show.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: 40 to 100 showy sterile flowers on the side of a mophead that faces the camera, so about 80 to 200 round the whole ball, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 177154494, 318011531, 388065803, 177154496, 89309857, 177447706, 328637493, 330196386): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 324, Hydrangea macrophylla: sterile flowers 1.5-3(-4) cm in diameter. A mophead's are the upper part of that range, 2.5 cm to 4 cm: in the photos each is about a fifth of its 10-20 cm head's width (iNaturalist observations 328637493, 304694460, 14822845; imagekit batch inat-2026-10-18-3).

traits.flower_merosity.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 324, Hydrangea macrophylla: sterile sepals 3-5, petaloid; drawn as four, as most of the photos show.

traits.flower_colour.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 324, Hydrangea macrophylla: sterile sepals pink or light blue, blue on acid soil; drawn light lilac blue as in most of the photos; sRGB by eye.

traits.fruit_type.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 324, Hydrangea macrophylla: fruit a capsule, (2-)3-locular, ovoid, ribbed.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 324, Hydrangea macrophylla: capsule 5-8 mm long including styles.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 324, Hydrangea macrophylla: capsule brown; sRGB by eye.

traits.flowering_months.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 324, Hydrangea macrophylla: flowering June to August.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 324, Hydrangea macrophylla: fruiting September to November.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a rounded many-stemmed shrub of large, glossy, coarsely toothed leaves in pairs, crowned with blue to lilac mopheads.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for bigleaf hydrangea from its sources and the photos the traits cite; the rest of its growth comes from the library's rules for the form. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 1.6 m tall at 12 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the core-species expansion, phase C batch 3 (2026-10-18): sizes and forms from Abrams, FEIS and Dendrology, counts from photos.
